metadata.description: Chinese dynasties (beyond Three Kingdoms) and Indian subcontinent cluster — emperors, warriors, cultural figures, and major media works. Two of the most underrepresented regions.

figures.name: Genghis Khan
figures.title: Founder of the Mongol Empire
figures.description: United the Mongol tribes and conquered the largest contiguous land empire in history, from China to Eastern Europe, fundamentally reshaping the medieval world

figures.name: Kublai Khan
figures.title: Emperor of the Yuan dynasty
figures.description: Grandson of Genghis Khan who founded the Yuan dynasty, unifying China under Mongol rule and hosting Marco Polo at his court in Xanadu

figures.name: Wu Zetian
figures.title: Empress Regnant of China
figures.description: The only woman in Chinese history to rule as emperor in her own right, founding the brief Zhou dynasty after rising from concubine to the most powerful person in China

figures.name: Qianlong Emperor
figures.title: Emperor of the Qing dynasty
figures.description: Presided over the zenith of the Qing dynasty, expanding the empire to its greatest territorial extent and amassing one of the world's largest art collections

figures.name: Sun Yat-sen
figures.title: Founding Father of the Republic of China
figures.description: Revolutionary who overthrew the Qing dynasty and established the Republic of China, revered as the Father of the Nation by both mainland China and Taiwan

figures.name: Confucius
figures.title: Philosopher and teacher
figures.description: The most influential Chinese philosopher whose teachings on ethics, family, and governance shaped East Asian civilization for over two millennia

figures.name: Hua Mulan
figures.title: Legendary warrior
figures.description: Legendary Chinese warrior woman who disguised herself as a man to serve in the army in place of her aging father, immortalized in the Ballad of Mulan

figures.name: Ashoka
figures.title: Emperor of the Maurya Empire
figures.description: One of India's greatest emperors who conquered most of the subcontinent, then renounced violence and embraced Buddhism after the bloody Kalinga War, spreading dharma across Asia

figures.name: Chandragupta Maurya
figures.title: Founder of the Maurya Empire
figures.description: Founded the Maurya Empire, the first great Indian dynasty to unify most of the subcontinent, guided by the legendary strategist Chanakya

figures.name: Chanakya
figures.title: Statesman and philosopher
figures.description: Ancient Indian political philosopher and strategist who authored the Arthashastra, guided Chandragupta Maurya to power, often called the Indian Machiavelli

figures.name: Tipu Sultan
figures.title: Ruler of the Kingdom of Mysore
figures.description: The Tiger of Mysore who pioneered the use of iron-cased rockets in warfare and fiercely resisted British expansion, dying in battle defending his capital Seringapatam

figures.name: Rani Lakshmibai
figures.title: Queen of Jhansi
figures.description: The warrior queen who led her forces against the British during the Indian Rebellion of 1857, becoming a symbol of Indian resistance and national pride

figures.name: Subhas Chandra Bose
figures.title: Indian nationalist leader
figures.description: Charismatic independence leader who formed the Indian National Army to fight the British with Japanese support during WWII, his death remains shrouded in mystery

figures.name: Jawaharlal Nehru
figures.title: First Prime Minister of India
figures.description: India's first Prime Minister who shaped the modern nation through democratic institution-building, non-alignment, and industrialization during the Cold War

figures.name: Rabindranath Tagore
figures.title: Poet, philosopher, and Nobel laureate
figures.description: First non-European Nobel Prize winner in literature, whose poetry, music, and educational philosophy profoundly shaped Bengali culture and the Indian independence movement

figures.name: Ranjit Singh
figures.title: First Maharaja of the Sikh Empire
figures.description: The Lion of the Punjab who united the Sikh misls into a powerful empire, renowned for religious tolerance and a modernized army trained by European officers

figures.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah
figures.title: Founder of Pakistan
figures.description: Lawyer and politician who led the movement for a separate Muslim homeland, becoming the first Governor-General of Pakistan at independence in 1947

figures.name: Prithviraj Chauhan
figures.title: King of Ajmer and Delhi
figures.description: Rajput king who defeated Muhammad of Ghor at the First Battle of Tarain but was defeated and killed at the Second Battle, marking the beginning of Muslim rule in North India

works.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
works.creator: Ang Lee
works.description: Wuxia masterpiece following warriors in pursuit of a stolen sword and a willful young aristocrat who hides a stunning secret, set in Qing dynasty China

works.title: Hero
works.creator: Zhang Yimou
works.description: Visually stunning wuxia film about an assassin who tells the King of Qin three versions of how he defeated three legendary warriors, each told in a different color

works.title: The Last Emperor
works.creator: Bernardo Bertolucci
works.description: Epic biographical film tracing Puyi's life from child emperor of the Qing dynasty through puppet ruler of Manchukuo to common citizen of the People's Republic

works.title: Curse of the Golden Flower
works.creator: Zhang Yimou
works.description: Lavish Tang dynasty drama about an empress plotting rebellion against her husband the emperor, a story of treachery and ambition within the imperial palace

works.title: Mulan
works.creator: Tony Bancroft
works.description: Disney animated film about a young Chinese woman who disguises herself as a soldier to save her father, becoming a hero who saves all of China from the Huns

works.title: Marco Polo
works.creator: Giuliano Montaldo
works.description: Epic miniseries following the Venetian merchant's 24-year journey to the court of Kublai Khan, depicting the wonders and dangers of the Silk Road

works.title: Gandhi
works.creator: Richard Attenborough
works.description: Epic biographical film spanning Mahatma Gandhi's life from his formative experience of racism in South Africa through India's independence and his assassination

works.title: Lagaan
works.creator: Ashutosh Gowariker
works.description: Indian villagers during the British Raj challenge their colonial rulers to a cricket match to avoid paying a crippling land tax, India's first Oscar-nominated Bollywood film

works.title: Bajirao Mastani
works.creator: Sanjay Leela Bhansali
works.description: Epic Bollywood drama about the Maratha Peshwa Bajirao I's forbidden love for the Muslim warrior princess Mastani, set against 18th-century Indian power politics

works.title: Padmaavat
works.creator: Sanjay Leela Bhansali
works.description: Lavish historical epic about the legendary Rajput queen Padmavati, the obsession of Sultan Alauddin Khilji, and the siege of Chittor Fort

works.title: Jodhaa Akbar
works.creator: Ashutosh Gowariker
works.description: Epic romance depicting the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Hindu Rajput princess Jodhaa that became a genuine love story and symbol of religious harmony

properties.notes: Qin Shi Huang is the King of Qin in the film
Ashoka-era themes of imperial unification echo the film
